# Link between baseline intention and endline outcome: Alluvial plot on all

```{r}


library(ggalluvial)


# Ensure your data is in the correct format for ggalluvial
alluvial_data <- MainDB %>%
  dplyr::select(ChildcareTypeEndline, ChildcareTypeBaseline, Assignment) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ChildcareTypeBaseline) & !is.na(ChildcareTypeEndline))

# Create the alluvial plot
ggplot(alluvial_data,
       aes(axis1 = ChildcareTypeBaseline, axis2 = ChildcareTypeEndline)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = ChildcareTypeBaseline), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "gray") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Desired Care (During Pregnancy)", "Actual Care (Endline)"),
                   expand = c(0.15, 0.15)) +
  theme_minimal() 
```

On controls only with applications

```{r}

# Ensure your data is in the correct format for ggalluvial
alluvial_data_Controls <- Control %>%
  dplyr::select(ChildcareTypeEndline, ChildcareTypeBaseline, ECSApp) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ChildcareTypeBaseline) & !is.na(ChildcareTypeEndline)) %>% 
  mutate(ECSApp = ifelse(ECSApp == 1, "Applied", "Did not apply"))

# Create the alluvial plot
ggplot(alluvial_data_Controls,
       aes(axis1 = ChildcareTypeBaseline, axis2 = ECSApp, axis3 =  ChildcareTypeEndline)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = ChildcareTypeBaseline), width = 1/12) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "gray") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Desired Care (During Pregnancy)", "Actual Care (Endline)"),
                   expand = c(0.15, 0.15)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Flow of Early Childcare Preferences to Actual Care",
       x = "Stages",
       y = "Number of Families")
       

```

Low-SES vs High SES

1\) High-SES

```{r}

alluvial_data_Controls_LowSES <- Control %>% filter(Educ == "Bac") %>%    dplyr::select(ChildcareTypeEndline, ChildcareTypeBaseline, ECSApp) %>%   dplyr::filter(!is.na(ChildcareTypeBaseline) & !is.na(ChildcareTypeEndline)) %>%    mutate(ECSApp = ifelse(ECSApp == 1, "Applied", "Did not apply"))  

# Create the alluvial plot 
ggplot(alluvial_data_Controls_LowSES,        aes(axis1 = ChildcareTypeBaseline, axis2 = ECSApp, axis3 =  ChildcareTypeEndline)) +   geom_alluvium(aes(fill = ChildcareTypeBaseline), width = 1/12) +   geom_stratum(width = 1/12, fill = "gray") +   geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +   scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Desired Care (During Pregnancy)", "Actual Care (Endline)"),                    expand = c(0.15, 0.15)) +   theme_minimal() +   labs(title = "Flow of Early Childcare Preferences to Actual Care",        x = "Stages",        y = "Number of Families")

```

# Logit regressions 

```{r logit}
cm <- c( '(Intercept)' = 'Constant', 'EducSup' = 'Level of Education of the mother: High-SES', "ECSApp"= "Applied")

logit1 <- glm(AccessInformalFullTime ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit2 <- glm(i(LevelInformation, ref = "Low knowledge")~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit3 <- glm(TrustEarlyChildcareAgree ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit4 <- glm(ECAccessHoursFit ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit5 <- glm(NegativeImpactSalary ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit6 <- glm(Active ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit7 <- glm(ProgressiveNorms ~ Educ,data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit8 <- glm(NegativeImpactWellBeing ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit9 <- glm(NegativeImpactCareer ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
logit10 <- glm(NormsUseMostToAll ~ Educ, data = DummiesSocioDemo, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modelsummary(
  list(
    "Access to Informal Care" = logit1,
    "Level of Information" = logit2,
    "Trust in Early Childcare facilities" = logit3,
    "Opening hours fit" = logit4,
    "Negative perceived impact on salary" = logit5,
    "Active" = logit6,
    "Adherence to progressive norms" = logit7,
    "Negative perceived impact on well-being" = logit8,
    "Negative perceived impact on career" = logit9,
    "Norms: Use most to all" = logit10
  ), 
  statistic = "{std.error} ({p.value})",
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}  [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]",
  gof_map = c("r.squared" ,"adj.r.squared", "aic", "bic", "nobs"),
  stars = c("***" = .01, "**" = .05, "*" = .1),
  title = "Probability to be satisfied with the current childcare solution according to education level and ECEC used",
  notes = list(
    "",
    "Coefficient, 95 % CI in brackets, standard errors, p-value or adjusted p-value in parenthesis"
  ),
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  output = 'flextable',
  escape = TRUE
) |> autofit()

```
